#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    while (cin >> n >> s) {
        bool ok = false;
        int one = 0;
        string tt = "";
        string twoans = "";
        bool wordnok = true;
        for (int c = 0; c < n; ++c) {
            char ch = s[c];
            if (ch == '(') {
                ok = true;
                wordnok = true;
                tt = "";
            } else if (ch == ')') {
                tt = "";
                ok = false;
            } else {
                if (!ok) {
                    if (ch == '_') {
                        tt = "";
                    } else {
                        tt += ch;
                    }
                    if (tt.length() > twoans.length()) {
                        twoans = tt;
                    }
                } else {
                    if (ch == '_') {
                        wordnok = true;
                    } else {
                        if (wordnok) {
                            ++one;
                            wordnok = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        cout << twoans.length() << " " << one << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
